purpose: decide whether a CONFIRMED-malignancy classifier is scientifically supportable

label_sources.radiologist_suspicion: nodules.csv malignancy_score = median of 1-5 subjective ratings per nodule (>=1 reader). NOT pathology.
label_sources.diagnosis_sheet: aux/tcia-diagnosis-data-2012-04-20.xls (TCIA, 157 patients): patient-level and per-nodule diagnosis + method.

diagnosis_sheet.metastatic_rows_dropped_from_lung_cancer: metastatic disease is malignant but is NOT primary lung cancer; kept separate

linkage_problem: The sheet's 'Nodule k' index follows the original LIDC XML nodule numbering. The mirror's nodule_id comes from QIICR TrackingUID clustering. No crosswalk is provided, so sheet nodules cannot be assigned to specific mirror nodules/masks without manual verification. Only patients with exactly ONE clustered nodule in the mirror could be linked unambiguously.

radiologist_suspicion_task.caveat: median of readers' subjective 1-5 ratings; ordinal target; inter-reader disagreement is large

decision.reason: only 31 unambiguously linkable labelled nodules; no nodule crosswalk; too few for patient-level train/val/test with CIs
